name: Media
description: Video, audio and galleries. Crystal named none of these before, and they are the clearest case of the parity requirement being about capability rather than nomenclature: a design system without a transport control leaves every product to invent one, and each invention re-solves captions, scrubbing and keyboard transport differently.

components.name: Video player
components.anatomy: A video surface with Crystal transport controls.
components.material: Resin control bar over the video; Haze fills behind readable labels
components.geometry: Control bar is a pill; every control reaches 44px.
components.semantics: Native video element underneath. Controls are real buttons, captions are supported and their state is announced, and keyboard shortcuts do not trap focus.
components.crystal: Control-bar material, transport geometry, the motion of showing and hiding controls

components.name: Audio player
components.anatomy: An audio transport with scrubbing and volume.
components.material: Resin plane with Haze readable regions
components.geometry: Pill; the scrubber is a slider with a 44px thumb.
components.semantics: A real audio element. The scrubber is a slider announcing time, not a progress bar.

components.name: Media controls
components.anatomy: The shared transport used by both players.
components.semantics: Each control is a button with a name; play and pause are one toggle with a pressed state.
components.crystal: Materials, the press recipe on every control

components.name: Gallery
components.anatomy: A set of media with a full-screen viewer.
components.material: Thumbnails are Haze; the viewer sits on a Mirage scrim
components.geometry: Thumbnails keep the content radius; the viewer is full-bleed within the scrim.
components.semantics: The viewer is a dialog: focus is contained, Escape closes, and arrows move between items with position announced.
components.crystal: Scrim material, thumbnail material, the transition between thumbnail and viewer
components.product: The media set and its captions

components.name: Lightbox
components.anatomy: A single media item enlarged over a scrim.
components.material: Mirage scrim; the item sits above it
components.geometry: The item keeps its own aspect; the scrim is full-bleed.
components.semantics: A dialog. Zoom and pan are keyboard reachable, and closing returns focus to the thumbnail.
components.crystal: Scrim material, the open and close motion
